newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saint Louis sees better 1997 prospects.
newsitem.headline: Saint Louis sees better 1997 prospects.

text.p: Saint Louis predicted on Thursday improved results for its core sugar and paper sectors in 1997.
In a statement Saint Louis said business for the sugar branch was in line with forecasts and "should once more generate satisfactory results, primarily due to a very good end 1996 sugar harvest",

"The recovery in results for the paper sector that started in the second half of 1996 should continue in 1997, helped by the effects of restructuring measures begun at the end of 1995 and providing that the economic outlook remains stable," it said.
